Name: p2e1_open_000
Text: A small studio, red ON AIR light. Nila, twenty-six, headphones on, hosting her new late show on a Windsor station.

Name: p2e1_open_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: …and that's why you never trust a man who says he "doesn't really like music". Next up, something slow for the night shift—

Name: p2e1_open_002
Text: She coughs. Covers her mouth. Looks at her palm. Blood. She keeps her voice perfectly steady.

Name: p2e1_open_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: —here it is.

Name: p2e1_open_004
Text: She presses play. The song starts. She slides off her chair onto the floor. The ON AIR light stays red.

Name: p2e1_hosp_000
Text: A blur. You and Preethi running through emergency doors. Scans. Waiting rooms. Preethi in her hospital pharmacy uniform, between shifts. An oncologist, Dr. Singh, with a tablet.

Name: p2e1_hosp_001
Speaker: DR. SINGH
Text: It's aggressive. And it's atypical. Honestly, I've never seen a progression like this. We'll start treatment, but I won't pretend I understand it.

Name: p2e1_hosp_002
Text: Preethi reads the blood panel over his shoulder. She stops on one line.

Name: p2e1_hosp_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: What's this compound? It's not on any standard panel.

Name: p2e1_hosp_004
Speaker: DR. SINGH
Text: The lab flagged it as an artefact.

Name: p2e1_hosp_005
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (quietly, to you) It's not an artefact.

Name: p2e1_hosp_006
Text: Amma and Appa arrive from Chennai, still in travel clothes. Amma takes Nila's hand.

Name: p2e1_hosp_007
Speaker: AMMA
Text: Kanna… enna aachu unakku?
Subtitle: My dear… what happened to you?

Name: p2e1_hosp_008
Speaker: NILA
Text: Onnum illa, Amma. Konjam blood, avlo dhaan.
Subtitle: It's nothing, Amma. Just a little blood, that's all.

Name: p2e1_hosp_009
Speaker: APPA
Text: Unmaiya sollu. Evlo serious?
Subtitle: Tell me the truth. How serious?

Name: p2e1_hosp_010
Speaker: MANI
Text: Romba serious, Appa.
Subtitle: Very serious, Appa.

Name: p2e1_case_000
Text: Nila props herself up, a notepad on her knees. You and Preethi on the visitor chairs.

Name: p2e1_case_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Okay. Treat it like a case. Exposure. Opportunity. Motive.

Name: p2e1_case_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Exposure: Old Merrow. I dived in that water twice. But Anna, you dived too, and you're fine.

Name: p2e1_case_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: So it's something only you had.

Name: p2e1_case_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: Pike Point. Six days in that shed. (beat) The water bottles.

Name: p2e1_case_005
Text: She hands you her ham handheld.

Name: p2e1_case_006
Speaker: NILA
Text: Call Jonah. He's always on, after dark.

Name: p2e1_jonah_000
Speaker: JONAH
Text: Pike Point, go ahead. (beat) Nila? Kid, is that you?

Name: p2e1_jonah_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Jonah. The water in the shed. Did you leave it for me?

Name: p2e1_jonah_002
Speaker: JONAH
Text: I told you last year, kid. I never brought you water.

Name: p2e1_jonah_003
Text: Nila lowers the radio.

Name: p2e1_jonah_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: Yaaro naan andha thanni kudikkanumnu nenachirukkaanga, Anna.
Subtitle: Someone wanted me to drink that water, Anna.

Name: p2e1_jonah_005
Text: Preethi has gone very still.

Name: p2e1_jonah_006
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: If someone put something in it… there'd be a record. A supplier. A delivery.

Name: p2e1_jonah_007
Speaker: NILA
Text: Then go and find it. Greyhaven. The mill. Victor kept everything.

Name: p2e1_drive_000
Text: You and Preethi drive east on the county roads you swore you'd never drive again. Preethi reads Nila's notes by phone light.

Name: p2e1_drive_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: She wrote "GH-01" here and circled it three times.

Name: p2e1_drive_002
Text: A Tom Portons stop. Harold and June at the window table.

Name: p2e1_drive_003
Speaker: HAROLD
Text: The data fella! June, it's the data fella!

Name: p2e1_drive_004
Speaker: JUNE
Text: Still on decaf, Harold, don't get excited.

Name: p2e1_drive_005
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (whispering) You know these people?

Name: p2e1_drive_006
Speaker: MANI
Text: Long story. It involved a cat phone case.

Name: p2e1_mill_000
Text: A blackened shell behind police tape. A private guard in a hut with a space heater. Ruth, a year older, scanner on her belt, shotgun on her shoulder, meets you at the fence.

Name: p2e1_mill_001
Speaker: RUTH
Text: Corbin's in prison. Victor's in the ground. And nobody in this town says the name Hades out loud.

Name: p2e1_mill_002
Speaker: RUTH
Text: (to Preethi) You must be the wife. He talks about you on the phone to Nila. Nauseating.

Name: p2e1_mill_003
Speaker: RUTH
Text: Guard changes at two-fifteen. You've got ten minutes.

Name: p2e1_mill_004
Text: Preethi climbs the water tower ladder with binoculars. You wait at the fence for her call.

Name: p2e1_mill2_000
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: He's in the hut. Heater's on. He's watching something on his phone. Go now. Stay left, along the wall.

Name: p2e1_mill2_001
Text: You cross the yard in the shadows. Halfway, Preethi's voice again, sharp:

Name: p2e1_mill2_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Stop. He's standing up.

Name: p2e1_mill3_000
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: …He's just stretching. Okay. Go.

Name: p2e1_mill3_001
Text: Victor's office is a burned box open to the sky. In the corner, his fireproof safe survived, blackened but whole. A keypad. You remember this keypad. You remember his love of anniversaries.

Name: p2e1_safe_000
Text: The safe door swings open. Ash and papers. Two things matter.

Name: p2e1_safe_001
Text: A shipping label: "NORTHSTAR BIOLOGICS — HX-7 — HAYDEN DEEP, RED LAKE, ON."

Name: p2e1_safe_002
Text: A delivery note: "24 × spring water, 1 L. Pike Point. Attn: GH-01." Dated the week Nila hid there.

Name: p2e1_safe_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: Anni. GH-01. It's her. She was a subject. A test subject.

Name: p2e1_safe_004
Text: Silence on the radio. Then, very tight:

Name: p2e1_safe_005
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Get out. Guard's coming your way.

Name: p2e1_safe_hide_000
Text: The flashlight passes over the ash a metre from your boots. The guard yawns, scratches, and walks back to his heater. You slip out the way you came.

Name: p2e1_safe_run_000
Text: The guard shouts. Before he reaches the fence, a shotgun blast booms into the sky from the road. Ruth. The guard dives for his hut. You're over the fence and gone.

Name: p2e1_plan_000
Text: The label and the note on Nila's bed tray. Nila looks stronger, the way people do when they have a job.

Name: p2e1_plan_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Red Lake. Northwestern Ontario. Gold country. End of the road. (She taps the label.) Northstar Biologics, registered 2015. Director: M. Hayden. The same Hayden from the plaque at the station. Victor's "Mark".

Name: p2e1_plan_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: He's not hiding, Anna. He's waiting.

Name: p2e1_plan_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Then we take it to the police.

Name: p2e1_plan_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: With what? A label from a burned building. Ortiz already tried; the OPP said Greyhaven is closed. (beat) Hades has the cure. I'd bet my life on it. I am betting my life on it.

Name: p2e1_plan_005
Speaker: MANI
Text: Then we go.

Name: p2e1_plan_006
Speaker: NILA
Text: Then you go prepared. Kane's people shot at you in Greyhaven. Up there it'll be worse. (beat) Which brings us to the guns.

Name: p2e1_plan_007
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: We can buy hunting rifles, right? People up north have them.

Name: p2e1_plan_008
Speaker: NILA
Text: Legally? A licence takes months: a course, a test, background checks. An M4-style rifle is prohibited in Canada, full stop. A Desert Eagle is a restricted handgun; you'd need a special licence just to drive it anywhere. Grenades, forget it.

Name: p2e1_plan_009
Speaker: NILA
Text: We don't have months, Anni. I have weeks.

Name: p2e1_plan_010
Speaker: MANI
Text: So what are you saying?

Name: p2e1_plan_011
Speaker: NILA
Text: I studied criminals for four years. Tonight I need one. (She opens her laptop.) Rocco Delisle. Auto body shop off Wyandotte West. Charged twice, never convicted. Brings guns over the river from Detroit. I covered his second trial for a class project. I know what he sells, what he charges, and that he's terrified of court.

Name: p2e1_plan_012
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Nila, this is a crime.

Name: p2e1_plan_013
Speaker: NILA
Text: So is what's happening in my blood. (beat) Anni, I'll understand if you don't go.

Name: p2e1_deal_000
Text: Rain. The bridge's lights above, trucks rumbling across to Detroit. A grey van with its rear doors open. Rocco Delisle, fifties, leather jacket, two silent men behind him.

Name: p2e1_deal_001
Text: Nila is on the radio in your ear, from her hospital bed.

Name: p2e1_deal_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Let him talk first. He likes the sound of his own voice.

Name: p2e1_deal_003
Speaker: ROCCO
Text: The radio girl's brother. She sent me a very polite message. Mentioned my court dates. Very polite.

Name: p2e1_deal_004
Text: He opens a case.

Name: p2e1_deal_005
Speaker: ROCCO
Text: Pump shotgun, twelve-gauge. M4, clean, no serial. Two Desert Eagles. Ammo. Forty grand.

Name: p2e1_deal_006
Speaker: NILA
Text: He charged the last buyer twenty-two. Say twenty-five.

Name: p2e1_deal2_000
Speaker: ROCCO
Text: (sighing) Your sister should be a lawyer. 26.

Name: p2e1_deal2_001
Text: Preethi steps forward to inspect the weapons. She handles them like she handles a pharmacy order: everything checked, nothing assumed.

Name: p2e1_deal3_000
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: This one's dead, Rocco. The pin's filed.

Name: p2e1_deal3_001
Text: Rocco laughs and swaps it from the van without argument.

Name: p2e1_deal3_002
Speaker: ROCCO
Text: Your sister said you were sharp. She didn't say it was the wife.

Name: p2e1_deal3_003
Text: Headlights on the riverfront road above. A police cruiser, rolling slowly.

Name: p2e1_deal3_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: Patrol car, westbound. Ninety seconds. Close the doors.

Name: p2e1_deal_ok_000
Text: The cruiser slows. An officer glances down at three men and a woman by a van in the rain. Rocco lifts a coffee cup in greeting. The cruiser rolls on.

Name: p2e1_deal_ok_001
Speaker: ROCCO
Text: No grenades. I'm not crazy. (He pockets the cash.) And tell your sister: if she ever mentions my court dates again, I'll stop being polite.

Name: p2e1_deal_run_000
Text: The cruiser's brake lights flare. Rocco's men scatter. You throw the cases into your trunk and Rocco shouts the last of the ammo boxes after you. You're gone before the cruiser turns.

Name: p2e1_deal_run_001
Text: You got the guns. Less ammunition than you paid for.

Name: p2e1_shop_000
Text: Day 1. Nila reads the list over the radio from her bed while you and Preethi push a cart through a huge outdoor store.

Name: p2e1_shop_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Red Lake in November can drop below minus thirty at night. Phones die in the cold. The cell signal ends before Red Lake does. Do not drink any water up there you didn't filter yourself. Ever.

Name: p2e1_shop_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Ever, Anna.

Name: p2e1_pack_000
Text: Now it all has to fit in the trunk.

Name: p2e1_bye_000
Text: At the curb, Amma presses a steel box into Preethi's hands.

Name: p2e1_bye_001
Speaker: AMMA
Text: Puliyodharai. Sudbury-ku munnadi saapdunga.
Subtitle: Tamarind rice. Eat it before Sudbury.

Name: p2e1_bye_002
Speaker: APPA
Text: Naanum varen.
Subtitle: I'm coming too.

Name: p2e1_bye_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: Appa, venaam. Nila-va paathukkonga. Adhu dhaan unga velai.
Subtitle: No, Appa. Look after Nila. That's your job.

Name: p2e1_bye_004
Text: Appa nods slowly and holds your face in both hands. He doesn't say anything. He doesn't have to.

Name: p2e1_bye_005
Text: Preethi gets in the passenger seat and puts on her seatbelt with great precision, the way she does when she's frightened.

Name: p2e1_parry_000
Text: Highway 401, then 400 north. Rock cuts and pine. At a Tom Portons near Parry Sound, a woman in a grey coat jumps up from her booth.

Name: p2e1_parry_001
Speaker: WOMAN
Text: My bag! My laptop bag was right here!

Name: p2e1_parry2_000
Text: Preethi taps on the hatchback window and gives the two boys a look she normally saves for doctors who prescribe the wrong dose. They hand the bag over without a word.

Name: p2e1_parry2_001
Speaker: WOMAN
Text: Thank you. Really. (beat) I'm Ivy.

Name: p2e1_parry2_002
Text: Ivy Laurent, mid-thirties. She thanks you a little too carefully. She glances at your face like she's checking it against a photo. Then she leaves, heading north.

Name: p2e1_sudbury_000
Text: A tired roadside motel. Through the window, the lit-up Big Nickel. You eat Amma's puliyodharai cross-legged on the bed.

Name: p2e1_sudbury_001
Text: Your phone buzzes: "Unknown tracker detected travelling with you."

Name: p2e1_tracker_000
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Smash it?

Name: p2e1_day2_000
Text: Day 2. Lake Superior opens up: huge, grey, empty, like the sea. Preethi presses her face to the window like a child.

Name: p2e1_day2_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: This is a lake? This is a LAKE?

Name: p2e1_day2_002
Text: At a Tom Portons in Sault Ste. Marie, the cashier is in tears. The staff tip jar has vanished.

Name: p2e1_wawa_000
Text: At the giant Canada goose statue in Wawa, snow starting. Ivy is there, photographing it.

Name: p2e1_wawa_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: That's not a coincidence.

Name: p2e1_ivy_000
Text: Ivy's room, two doors down. A laptop, maps, a bottle of wine she isn't drinking.

Name: p2e1_ivy_001
Speaker: IVY
Text: Your sister emailed me last year. From Greyhaven. I never wrote back. (beat) I'm sorry. I was hiding.

Name: p2e1_ivy_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: From who?

Name: p2e1_ivy_003
Speaker: IVY
Text: From Northstar. I was a lab tech there for two years before I became a journalist. I saw what HX-7 does. I took a photo of one file, quit, and ran.

Name: p2e1_ivy_004
Text: She draws a rough map of the surface buildings: gatehouse, office, loading dock, and a freight elevator that goes deeper than the mine maps say.

Name: p2e1_ivy_005
Speaker: NILA
Text: Put me on speaker. I want to ask her three things. In the right order.

Name: p2e1_ivy2_000
Speaker: IVY
Text: Badge 0417. Dr. Lund. Clear, with a faint blue tint under UV. (beat) And I didn't answer because I was scared, Nila. That's all. I'm sorry.

Name: p2e1_ivy2_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: She's telling the truth. Mostly. (beat) Welcome to the team, Ivy.

Name: p2e1_cliff_000
Text: Snow on the window. Preethi asleep. You awake, the handheld on the bedside table, tuned to your private frequency.

Name: p2e1_cliff_001
Text: It crackles. A calm voice. The voice from the water tower in Greyhaven.

Name: p2e1_cliff_002
Speaker: HADES
Text: Welcome to the north, Mani. Bring the file. (beat) And tell your sister: GH-01 is doing very well.

Name: p2e1_cliff_003
Text: Preethi's eyes open in the dark.

Name: p2e1_end_000
Text: End of Episode 1.

Name: p2e2_open_000
Text: Wawa behind you. Ivy's dented hatchback ahead. Snow on the shoulders. Preethi has the Hades recording on repeat on her phone.

Name: p2e2_open_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: "GH-01 is doing very well." He talks about her like a houseplant.

Name: p2e2_open_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: That's what he wants you to feel. Angry people make mistakes. (cough) Don't give him that.

Name: p2e2_open_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: Nila, how are you feeling?

Name: p2e2_open_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: Amma made me eat idli at six a.m. I'm feeling attacked. (beat) Drive, Anna.

Name: p2e2_winnie_000
Text: A tiny town. A sign: Home of Winnie. A statue of a bear cub in a tree: the real bear that inspired Winnie-the-Pooh. A cluster of kids and a frazzled teacher.

Name: p2e2_winnie_001
Speaker: TEACHER
Text: Someone stole Winnie's scarf! The kids knitted it!

Name: p2e2_winnie_002
Text: Red wool fibres on the bark of the statue's tree. Twigs and droppings under the gas station sign across the road. Through your binoculars: a nest on top of the sign, with a flash of red.

Name: p2e2_winnie2_000
Text: Preethi climbs the gas station ladder, retrieves the scarf, and is attacked by an extremely angry crow. The kids cheer. You film all of it.

Name: p2e2_winnie2_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Anni lost a fight to a crow. Best day of my life.

Name: p2e2_winnie2_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: I WON. I have the scarf. I won.

Name: p2e2_winnie2_003
Text: At the pumps, a trucker with a grey beard and a CB radio watches you fill up.

Name: p2e2_winnie2_004
Speaker: BIG LOU
Text: You folks headed west? Two black SUVs been running Highway 17 all week. No front plates. They stop where nobody stops. (He spits.) You hear "Kane" on channel nineteen, you get off the road.

Name: p2e2_nipigon_000
Text: The cable-stayed bridge over the Nipigon River. Superior's frozen edge. At sunset, the Sleeping Giant on the horizon across the bay. Preethi asks you to stop the car. You stand in the cold and watch it.

Name: p2e2_nipigon_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Nee bayappadriya?
Subtitle: Are you scared?

Name: p2e2_nipigon_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: Romba.
Subtitle: Very. (beat) You?

Name: p2e2_nipigon_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: I'm a pharmacist, Mani. Last month my biggest problem was a doctor's handwriting.

Name: p2e2_nipigon_004
Text: She puts her cold hand in your coat pocket with yours.

Name: p2e2_okafor_000
Text: A warm house full of books. Dr. Grace Okafor, sixty, Nila's former criminology professor. Jollof rice and tea. Nila on speaker.

Name: p2e2_okafor_001
Speaker: DR. OKAFOR
Text: Nila was the best student I ever had, and she chose radio. I've never forgiven her.

Name: p2e2_okafor_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: You came to my first show.

Name: p2e2_okafor_003
Speaker: DR. OKAFOR
Text: I came to judge it. (To you.) Tell me about the man.

Name: p2e2_okafor2_000
Speaker: DR. OKAFOR
Text: He won't kill you from a distance, Mani. He'll want you in the room. He'll want to watch you choose.

Name: p2e2_okafor2_001
Text: She writes a name on a card.

Name: p2e2_okafor2_002
Speaker: DR. OKAFOR
Text: Constable Rachel Dunn, OPP, Red Lake. She was my student too. Honest. Too honest for her own good.

Name: p2e2_storm_000
Text: Whiteout. Visibility ten metres. A transport truck jackknifed across both lanes, hazard lights blinking in the snow.

Name: p2e2_storm_001
Speaker: BIG LOU
Text: …whoever's westbound by Ignace, that's no accident, I just came through—

Name: p2e2_storm_002
Text: Two black SUVs slide out of the snow behind you. Doors open. Men in white parkas with rifles.

Name: p2e2_storm_003
Speaker: KANE
Text: Mani. Just the file. Nobody has to freeze tonight.

Name: p2e2_storm_004
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Mani.

Name: p2e2_storm_005
Speaker: MANI
Text: I know.

Name: p2e2_storm_006
Text: You have seconds. The whiteout is your friend: if you move now, they haven't seen where you went.

Name: p2e2_fight1_000
Text: First fight. In stealth you can take them one by one in the snow. If they spot you, it turns into a firefight.

Name: p2e2_fight2_000
Text: A man on the roof of the jackknifed truck has seen the bodies. He opens up. The second SUV's driver tries to swing round to block your car.

Name: p2e2_case_000
Text: Silence, except the wind. Ivy's hatchback is full of bullet holes. Ivy is crouched behind it, shaking, unhurt.

Name: p2e2_case_001
Text: In the back of an SUV: a hard case stencilled NSB. Inside, in grey foam, six fragmentation grenades.

Name: p2e2_case_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (staring at it) These are grenades, Mani. Real grenades.

Name: p2e2_case_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: Then they're your grenades now. Put them in the trunk, Anni.

Name: p2e2_case_004
Text: You each take two. The rest go in the trunk.

Name: p2e2_dryden_000
Text: A motel by the highway. Preethi patches a graze on your arm. Neither of you sleeps much.

Name: p2e2_dryden_001
Text: Morning. The car won't start. There's fuel on the snow under the engine.

Name: p2e2_tyler_000
Text: Tyler sees your face and goes white.

Name: p2e2_tyler_a_000
Text: An OPP cruiser takes Tyler away. He won't say a word. A man with a scar on his chin paid him, is all he'll admit. You lose an hour giving statements.

Name: p2e2_tyler_b_000
Speaker: TYLER
Text: A guy paid me. Big. Scar on his chin. Said you were thieves.

Name: p2e2_tyler_b_001
Speaker: TYLER
Text: Every Thursday night they run a convoy up 105. Northstar trucks. They stop for fuel at Ear Falls at nine. Three trucks, sometimes four. Please don't tell anyone I told you.

Name: p2e2_ear_000
Text: Ivy and you fix the fuel line with tape and a hose clamp from her trunk. She turns back toward Dryden to get her own car repaired: "I'll catch up in Red Lake."

Name: p2e2_ear_001
Text: Highway 105 narrows to two lanes. Forest on both sides for 170 km. No cell signal. Then Ear Falls: a dam, a gas station, a diner. Pie and coffee.

Name: p2e2_ear_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Anna. Anni. Naan ungala nenachu romba perumai padaren.
Subtitle: I'm so proud of you both. (beat) Okay, that's enough emotions. Eat your pie.

Name: p2e2_arrive_000
Text: Snow falling. A gold-mining town on a frozen lake. Headframes against a violet sky. On the waterfront, the Norseman floatplane monument, frosted white.

Name: p2e2_arrive_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: It's beautiful.

Name: p2e2_arrive_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: Everything up here is beautiful. That's what scares me.

Name: p2e2_arrive_003
Text: The Northern Star Motel: twelve rooms, a coffee pot, a moose head over the desk. The owner, Bev Arsenault, reading glasses on her head, eyes your long cases.

Name: p2e2_arrive_004
Speaker: BEV
Text: Hunting?

Name: p2e2_arrive_005
Speaker: MANI
Text: Something like that.

Name: p2e2_arrive_006
Speaker: BEV
Text: Mm. Last person I had who was "something like that" was a girl from Toronto in 2024. Disappeared in the night, left her toothbrush. (She hands you a key.) Room seven. Checkout's at eleven. Murders are extra.

Name: p2e2_gift_000
Text: On the bed, a gift box with a silk ribbon. Preethi stops your hand.

Name: p2e2_gift_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Wait. (She checks it like a package at the pharmacy: no wires, no smell.) Okay.

Name: p2e2_gift_002
Text: Inside, on tissue paper: the shed skin of a golden lancehead. And a photo of Nila asleep in her hospital bed in Windsor, taken from inside her room. A card, in neat handwriting:

Name: p2e2_gift_003
Text: "Welcome to my town."

Name: p2e2_gift_004
Speaker: MANI
Text: Lighthouse! Nila! Answer me!

Name: p2e2_gift_005
Text: Static. Then Appa's voice, confused.

Name: p2e2_gift_006
Speaker: APPA
Text: Mani? Ava thoongittu irukkaa. Enna aachu?
Subtitle: Mani? She's sleeping. What happened?

Name: p2e2_gift_007
Speaker: MANI
Text: Appa, room-la yaarachum vandhaangala?
Subtitle: Appa, has anyone been in the room?

Name: p2e2_gift_008
Speaker: APPA
Text: Oru doctor vandhaaru, kaalaila. Romba nalla manushan. Nila-ku flowers kondu vandhaaru.
Subtitle: A doctor came this morning. A very nice man. He brought Nila flowers.

Name: p2e2_end_000
Text: End of Episode 2.

Name: p2e3_open_000
Text: You haven't slept. The radio on the bed. Ortiz's voice on it, from the highway.

Name: p2e3_open_001
Speaker: ORTIZ
Text: Took three days off. I'll sit outside her door in Windsor till you come home. Nobody brings her flowers but family. (beat) That's not a favour, Mani. I owe her.

Name: p2e3_open_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Sam's here. He brought Tom Portons. Okay. Plan for today, Anna. Hospital, museum, rocks.

Name: p2e3_hosp_000
Text: A small, clean hospital, snow piled at the doors. Preethi introduces herself at the desk as a visiting hospital pharmacist from Windsor, which is true, and asks for the director. She gets Dr. Helen Marchetti, fifty-two, sharp, tired, stethoscope worn like a necklace.

Name: p2e3_hosp_001
Speaker: DR. MARCHETTI
Text: Windsor? You drove all this way to ask about my formulary?

Name: p2e3_hosp_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: I drove all this way because my sister-in-law has a cancer nobody understands. (She hands over Nila's panel.) This compound. Have you seen it?

Name: p2e3_hosp_003
Text: Marchetti reads it. Closes her office door.

Name: p2e3_hosp_004
Speaker: DR. MARCHETTI
Text: Four times. Four men who did contract work at the Hayden Deep. All dead within five months. I sent samples to Winnipeg. The results came back "lost". Then Northstar donated a CT scanner to this hospital. (beat) I was told to stop asking.

Name: p2e3_hosp2_000
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Same compound. Same pattern. Different start dates. (beat) Nila's three weeks behind the last man.

Name: p2e3_hosp2_001
Speaker: DR. MARCHETTI
Text: (quietly) Then you have about three months. Maybe less.

Name: p2e3_hosp2_002
Text: Preethi doesn't move. You take her hand under the desk.

Name: p2e3_museum_000
Text: Gold pans, Norseman models, mine photographs. A volunteer docent, Mrs. Lindqvist, seventies, is delighted to have a visitor.

Name: p2e3_museum2_000
Speaker: MRS. LINDQVIST
Text: Mark came home in 2015. Bought the old mine, built a big house way out past the Burn. Nobody's ever been invited.

Name: p2e3_museum2_001
Speaker: MRS. LINDQVIST
Text: His father too, they say. Though old Robert must be ninety if he's a day.

Name: p2e3_museum2_002
Text: You write down "Robert".

Name: p2e3_overlook_000
Text: A lot overlooking the mine buildings and headframe. A.Y. Jackson painted this view once. You and Preethi eat the last of Amma's puliyodharai in the car, heater running.

Name: p2e3_overlook_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Three months.

Name: p2e3_overlook_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: Less.

Name: p2e3_overlook_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: What if the cure doesn't exist?

Name: p2e3_overlook_004
Speaker: MANI
Text: Then Hades wouldn't send presents. You don't brag about a lock unless you have the key.

Name: p2e3_rocks_000
Text: Cases of minerals: thousands of specimens, quartz, pyrite, real gold glinting under the lights. Somewhere in here are rocks from the Hayden Deep.

Name: p2e3_rocks2_000
Text: You borrow the case magnifier. Under the Level 6 label, an older typed tag, mostly hidden.

Name: p2e3_rocks3_000
Speaker: MANI
Text: The public mine maps show six levels.

Name: p2e3_rocks3_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: So there are three more nobody talks about. That's where the lab is, Anna.

Name: p2e3_dunn_000
Text: A call to your phone brings you in. Constable Rachel Dunn, thirty-three, ponytail, notebook, very direct.

Name: p2e3_dunn_001
Speaker: DUNN
Text: Two people from Windsor, long gun cases, asking about Northstar at the hospital and the museum. You know what that sounds like to me?

Name: p2e3_dunn2_000
Speaker: DUNN
Text: (writing) Why Northstar?

Name: p2e3_dunn3_000
Speaker: DUNN
Text: Grace taught me at Lakehead. (She closes her notebook.) I can't help you. I also can't arrest you for being sad.

Name: p2e3_dunn3_001
Speaker: DUNN
Text: Go home, Mr. Mani. Northstar pays half this town's wages. (beat) And if you don't go home, don't make me find you in a ditch.

Name: p2e3_daniel_000
Text: Planes on skis on the frozen bay. A man in a heavy parka works on the engine of an old Norseman. Daniel Keeper, forty-five.

Name: p2e3_daniel_001
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: You're the couple asking about Hayden Deep. (beat) My cousin Joe worked there. He was the third one who died.

Name: p2e3_daniel_002
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: There's a stretch of land past the Burn nobody's allowed to fly over. Northstar got a restriction put on it. I know every lake around it.

Name: p2e3_daniel_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: Would you fly us?

Name: p2e3_daniel_004
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: When it's time. Not before. (He looks at the gun cases in your back seat.) And not with those pointed at my plane.

Name: p2e3_cliff_000
Text: The nightly check-in. Nila reads the five blood panels back to you, voice thin.

Name: p2e3_cliff_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: …so if the peptide binds in the liver first, then the three-week lag means he dosed me in the—

Name: p2e3_cliff_002
Text: Her voice stops. A long electronic tone. Then voices in the room, running feet, the clatter of a falling tray. Then Amma.

Name: p2e3_cliff_003
Speaker: AMMA
Text: Kanna! Nurses vandhurukkaanga, ava moochu—
Subtitle: Kanna! The nurses are here, her breathing—

Name: p2e3_cliff_004
Text: Static.

Name: p2e3_end_000
Text: End of Episode 3.

Name: p2e4_open_000
Text: You and Preethi sit on the floor by the radio, coats still on. You've packed the car to drive back to Windsor. Static for six hours.

Name: p2e4_open_001
Text: Then a click.

Name: p2e4_open_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: …Anna. Anni. Naan inga dhaan irukken.
Subtitle: I'm still here. (beat) They gave me oxygen. Ortiz yelled at a doctor. It was very funny.

Name: p2e4_open_003
Text: Preethi puts her face in her hands and cries.

Name: p2e4_open_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: Unpack the car. (beat) Find the man who dug Level 9.

Name: p2e4_bar_000
Text: A low wooden bar with a store at the back. Trophy fish on the walls. Miners on shift break, steam rising off their jackets.

Name: p2e4_ice_000
Text: The summer ferry is gone. A ploughed road of ice crosses the dark lake, marked by small evergreen trees stuck in the snow. Thin near the shore, where the current runs.

Name: p2e4_ice_001
Text: Halfway across: headlights behind you. Three snowmobiles, fast.

Name: p2e4_ice2_000
Text: The snowmobiles close in on both sides.

Name: p2e4_ice2_001
Text: Preethi rolls down her window. Wind and snow pour in. She braces the shotgun on the door.

Name: p2e4_ice3_000
Text: The third snowmobile is still on you as the island shore rushes up.

Name: p2e4_ice_end_000
Text: You hit the shore road at speed and fishtail into a snowbank. The snowmobile roars past and away into the dark.

Name: p2e4_sully_000
Text: A cabin crammed with mining junk, a wood stove, and a black cat named Nugget. "Sully" O'Rourke, seventy-eight, takes the rye before he takes your names.

Name: p2e4_sully_001
Speaker: SULLY
Text: Hayden Deep. (He pours.) I dug Level Nine in seventy-four. Old Robert Hayden wanted a level nobody would ever see on a map. Said it was for "cold storage". I've dug gold for fifty years; you don't keep anything cold that far down. You keep it secret.

Name: p2e4_stories_000
Text: Sully refills his glass. "Ask me something."

Name: p2e4_s1_000
Speaker: SULLY
Text: Six of us. Nine months. Paid triple and told to forget it. We cut a vent raise up to the bush by Madsen so we could breathe down there. Nobody ever filled it in. I'd bet my cat on it.

Name: p2e4_s2_000
Speaker: SULLY
Text: In the eighties. Three of the six of us. Lungs. Same as everybody else on that road. Company paid for the funerals. Very generous. Very quiet.

Name: p2e4_s3_000
Speaker: SULLY
Text: Cold little thing. Used to catch garter snakes and keep them in jars on his windowsill. Watched them. Just watched them, for hours. Never let them go.

Name: p2e4_map_000
Text: Sully turns over a calendar from 1974. On the back, in pencil: a hand-drawn map. Levels 6 to 9, the shafts, and a ventilation raise that comes up in the bush near Madsen.

Name: p2e4_map_001
Speaker: SULLY
Text: Only map there is. Take it. (beat) And son. The old man never died, you know. They say he lives out there with the boy.

Name: p2e4_mapp_000
Text: You lay Sully's map over Ivy's surface sketch and the "Level 9" clue.

Name: p2e4_back_000
Speaker: NILA
Text: A side door nobody remembers. Every case has one. Good work, Anna.

Name: p2e4_back_001
Text: You cross back on the marked road, slowly. Where the snowmobile went through, the ice is already freezing over. Preethi is silent.

Name: p2e4_back_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: That man could have drowned.

Name: p2e4_back_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: He was shooting at us.

Name: p2e4_back_004
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: I know. (beat) I still want to remember that he could have drowned.

Name: p2e4_cliff_000
Text: The office door is open. Bev is duct-taped to her desk chair, a bruise on her cheek, furious.

Name: p2e4_cliff_001
Speaker: BEV
Text: (as Preethi cuts the tape) Three of them. One with a scar. They wanted the Toronto girl.

Name: p2e4_cliff_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: Ivy's in Dryden—

Name: p2e4_cliff_003
Speaker: BEV
Text: She came back tonight. Two hours ago. Room four.

Name: p2e4_cliff_004
Text: Room four: the door kicked in, the bed overturned, Ivy's laptop smashed. A drop of blood on the snow outside. Drag marks to where a vehicle waited.

Name: p2e4_cliff_005
Text: Your radio clicks onto your channel.

Name: p2e4_cliff_006
Speaker: KANE
Text: The journalist talks a lot when she's cold. (beat) Thursday, Mani. Bring the file. You can have whatever's left of her.

Name: p2e4_end_000
Text: End of Episode 4.

Name: p2e5_open_000
Text: Sully's map, Ivy's sketch and your notes spread on the bed. Nila on the radio, voice weak but precise.

Name: p2e5_open_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Kane expects you at the front gate at midnight with the file. So you'll be there, Anna, and you won't. Ivy told me Northstar runs a supply convoy on Thursdays; it fuels at Ear Falls at nine.

Name: p2e5_open_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Last truck, there's a gap between the pallets and the cab. You ride in. Anni takes the old ventilation raise near Madsen. You meet on Level 9.

Name: p2e5_open_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: And if one of us gets caught?

Name: p2e5_open_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: Then the other one is the plan. (beat) Bring me pictures. Bring me voices. Bring Ivy.

Name: p2e5_ear_000
Text: Three Northstar trucks fuelling under floodlights. The drivers are inside, buying coffee. You need to reach the last truck without being seen.

Name: p2e5_ear_001
Text: Between you and it: the ice machine, a parked snowplough, and twenty metres of bright concrete.

Name: p2e5_ear_seen_000
Text: A driver comes out with his coffee and looks right at you. You freeze in the shadow of the truck.

Name: p2e5_ear_caught_000
Text: The driver yells. You dive into the gap behind the cab as he comes round the corner with a flashlight. He swears, decides it was a raccoon, and climbs in. Your heart is louder than the engine.

Name: p2e5_ear2_000
Text: You fold yourself into the gap behind the cab. Diesel and cold metal. The truck pulls out. North.

Name: p2e5_vent_000
Text: Deep snow. Preethi follows Sully's map by headlamp to a rusted steel cap in the trees: the 1974 ventilation raise. She cuts the padlock with Ruth's old bolt cutters.

Name: p2e5_vent_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Lighthouse, I'm at the side door.

Name: p2e5_vent_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Three hundred metres of ladder, Anni. Don't look down. Actually, look down. Watch where you put your feet.

Name: p2e5_vent_003
Text: Halfway down, a rung snaps under her boot.

Name: p2e5_vent_slip_000
Text: She drops a metre and catches a rung with one hand, slamming her knee into the rock. She hangs there, breathing. Then she climbs on.

Name: p2e5_vent2_000
Text: A bat colony explodes past her face in the dark, hundreds of wings. She swears in Tamil, loudly. On the radio, Nila laughs weakly for the first time in days.

Name: p2e5_vent2_001
Text: Two hundred metres to go.

Name: p2e5_surface_000
Text: The truck rolls through the gate. Floodlights, the headframe, a modern glass office bolted onto old brick. You slip out at the loading dock.

Name: p2e5_surface_001
Text: Three guards between you and the freight elevator. A locker room. Cameras.

Name: p2e5_surface_clean_000
Text: Under the guard post bench: a hard case stencilled NSB. Grenades. And on a hook, a lab coat and an ID badge that opens the freight elevator to Level 6.

Name: p2e5_surface_loud_000
Text: An alarm starts somewhere and stops. They'll be looking now. Under the guard post bench: a hard case stencilled NSB. Grenades. You take the elevator badge from a guard's belt.

Name: p2e5_meet_000
Text: Preethi drops from the last rung into warm air. You find the old ramp down from Level 6. You meet in a tunnel lit by white LEDs. She grabs your coat with both hands and doesn't say anything.

Name: p2e5_meet_001
Text: Then the tunnel opens.

Name: p2e5_farm_000
Text: A cavern of heated glass tanks, hundreds of them, in rows that disappear into the dark. In every tank, a golden lancehead. Robotic arms move from tank to tank, pinning the snakes and milking venom into vials. Freezers hum.

Name: p2e5_farm_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (whispering) This is a farm. He's farming them.

Name: p2e5_server_000
Text: A clean lab behind glass. A server terminal. You plug in the USB with the encrypted file from Greyhaven. Hades_contacts.enc.

Name: p2e5_server_001
Text: It isn't a list of contacts. It's a key. The terminal asks for three fields to unlock the trial database.

Name: p2e5_files_000
Text: The records open.

Name: p2e5_files_001
Text: SUBJECT GH-01. Nila. "Route: drinking water. Location: Pike Point, Greyhaven. Progression: as expected." A scanned note in the margin, in neat handwriting: "Keep her alive until the brother comes. — M.H."

Name: p2e5_files_002
Text: SUBJECTS RL-01 to RL-04: the four dead men. Joe Keeper is RL-03.

Name: p2e5_files_003
Text: HX-7C (antidote): "Three doses. Stored at the house vault. Access: M.H. only."

Name: p2e5_files_004
Speaker: MANI
Text: Nila. He wrote your name. In his own handwriting.

Name: p2e5_files_005
Text: A long silence on the radio.

Name: p2e5_files_006
Speaker: NILA
Text: Then we have him on paper. Copy everything, Anna.

Name: p2e5_ivy_000
Text: Behind a steel door marked SAMPLES −4°C: Ivy, zip-tied to a shelf, lips blue, a bruise over one eye. Preethi cuts her free and wraps her in her own parka.

Name: p2e5_ivy_001
Speaker: IVY
Text: (teeth chattering) I came back to warn you. They were in the parking lot.

Name: p2e5_ivy_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: You're okay. I've got you. (She checks Ivy's pupils and fingers.) Early hypothermia. You'll keep your fingers.

Name: p2e5_ivy_003
Text: Alarms. Red lights. A voice on the PA.

Name: p2e5_ivy_004
Speaker: KANE
Text: Mani. You were supposed to come to the front door.

Name: p2e5_esc1_000
Text: Guards pour into the venom farm between the tank rows. They've been waiting.

Name: p2e5_esc2_000
Text: The old mine cage elevator. A slow ride up three hundred metres. Kane's men fire down the shaft from above.

Name: p2e5_cliff_000
Text: You crash through a gap in the fence into the bush and run, Ivy between you. Then lights everywhere, red and blue. A ring of OPP cruisers on the access road. A megaphone.

Name: p2e5_cliff_001
Speaker: DUNN
Text: Hands where I can see them. Both of you. Now.

Name: p2e5_cliff_002
Text: Preethi looks at the Desert Eagle in her hand, then at you. Behind you, on the mine road, Kane's SUVs stop, turn, and drive calmly away.

Name: p2e5_end_000
Text: End of Episode 5.

Name: p2e6_open_000
Text: In the two seconds before the floodlights reach you, Preethi does something fast: she shoves both Desert Eagles and the long guns into a snowbank behind a spruce and kicks snow over them.

Name: p2e6_open_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (under her breath) Illegal guns, Mani. Ninaivirukkaa?
Subtitle: Remember?

Name: p2e6_open_002
Text: You step out with your hands up, Ivy between you. Dunn pats you down: a USB stick, a phone full of photographs, a pocket of dried fruit.

Name: p2e6_dunn_000
Text: Dunn scrolls through the photos on your phone: the venom farm, the whiteboard, the GH-01 record. Ivy, wrapped in a blanket, gives a statement. Dunn's face changes.

Name: p2e6_dunn_001
Speaker: DUNN
Text: You broke into a private facility. I should charge you both.

Name: p2e6_dunn_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: Charge me. But read page four first.

Name: p2e6_dunn_003
Text: She reads it. "Keep her alive until the brother comes." She closes the laptop.

Name: p2e6_dunn_004
Speaker: DUNN
Text: I can't get a warrant for Northstar on photos from a break-in. The judge in Kenora golfs with Hayden's lawyer. And half this town's mortgages are paid by that mine.

Name: p2e6_dunn_005
Speaker: DUNN
Text: Officially, you were found lost on a snowmobile trail. (She slides the USB back.) Get your sister her medicine. And whatever you hid in that snowbank, I didn't see it.

Name: p2e6_amma_000
Text: No Nila. Instead, Amma's voice, and Appa beside her.

Name: p2e6_amma_001
Speaker: AMMA
Text: Kanna, Nila thoonguraa. Doctor sonnaaru, unconscious-nu. Konja naal aagalaam.
Subtitle: Kanna, Nila is sleeping. The doctor says she's unconscious. It may take a few days.

Name: p2e6_amma_002
Speaker: AMMA
Text: Aana naan inga irukken. Ava notes ellam en kitta irukku. Naan padichu solren.
Subtitle: But I'm here. I have all her notes. I'll read them to you.

Name: p2e6_amma_003
Text: Preethi sits down slowly on the bed.

Name: p2e6_kane_000
Text: The radio clicks onto your channel.

Name: p2e6_kane_001
Speaker: KANE
Text: You took the journalist. So I took the old man.

Name: p2e6_kane_002
Text: A cough, then Sully's voice, angry: "Don't you come, son!" A thud.

Name: p2e6_kane_003
Speaker: KANE
Text: Starratt-Olsen. Midnight. Not the file this time, Mani. You. Walk in alone.

Name: p2e6_kane_004
Speaker: APPA
Text: Mani. Nila ezhudhinadhu inga irukku: "Kane fights near water. Kane likes high ground." Idhu ungalukku purinjadha?
Subtitle: Mani. Nila wrote this here: "Kane fights near water. Kane likes high ground." Does this make sense to you?

Name: p2e6_kane_005
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Purinjudhu, Appa.
Subtitle: It does, Appa.

Name: p2e6_guns_000
Text: First, the guns. In daylight, by the mine fence, with Northstar patrols driving the access road every ten minutes.

Name: p2e6_guns_seen_000
Text: A patrol truck slows. You lie flat in the snow with a shotgun under you. The driver squints, shrugs, and drives on. Too close.

Name: p2e6_guns_ok_000
Text: Everything is there under the snow. Cold, dry, loaded.

Name: p2e6_town_000
Text: A near-ghost town. Empty houses with dark windows. A collapsed store. A little white church with a bell tower. Snow drifting through broken doors. A blizzard coming in off the lake.

Name: p2e6_town_001
Text: You walk down the middle of the road alone, as you were told. Preethi isn't with you. She's already in the church bell tower with the long gun.

Name: p2e6_town_002
Speaker: KANE
Text: Brave. Or stupid. Your wife's in the church, isn't she? (beat) That's fine. So's my sniper.

Name: p2e6_town_003
Speaker: AMMA
Text: Nila ezhudhiyirukka: "Kane likes high ground."
Subtitle: Nila wrote: "Kane likes high ground."

Name: p2e6_sniper_000
Text: Preethi scans the town through her scope. Snow everywhere. Then: a puff of breath fog from the highest roof in town, the old hotel.

Name: p2e6_houses_000
Text: Three houses between you and the one with a light in the window. In the first, a frightened local hiding with his dog. You get them out the back door into the storm.

Name: p2e6_houses_001
Text: Three of Kane's men in the next two houses, waiting.

Name: p2e6_sully_000
Text: In the last house, Sully, tied to a kitchen chair, blood in his white hair, alive.

Name: p2e6_sully_001
Speaker: SULLY
Text: (as you cut him loose) Told you not to come. (beat) Thank you for coming.

Name: p2e6_sully_002
Text: Outside, engines. Kane and four men, converging on the road.

Name: p2e6_road_000
Text: Preethi comes down from the tower at a run. The two of you, behind an old truck, against Kane.

Name: p2e6_after_000
Text: In Kane's abandoned truck: another hard case stencilled NSB. And a radio, still on Kane's channel.

Name: p2e6_wake_000
Text: The radio, after a day and a half of Amma's voice, clicks. A different breath on the line.

Name: p2e6_wake_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: …Anna… Anni… naan ellathaiyum kettukittu irundhen.
Subtitle: I heard everything.

Name: p2e6_wake_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: Jonah got me a thermal image. Public satellite. North-west of the Burn there's only one heat source in four hundred square kilometres. A house. And behind it, something hot. Very hot.

Name: p2e6_wake_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: That's where the cure is.

Name: p2e6_wake_004
Speaker: NILA
Text: That's where he is. (beat) Call Daniel.

Name: p2e6_flight_000
Text: The Norseman on skis, engine roaring. Daniel at the controls, you beside him, Preethi behind with the guns. The town shrinks below.

Name: p2e6_flight_001
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: Northstar got this airspace restricted. Not illegal to fly. Just unwise. (He grins.) Joe would've liked you.

Name: p2e6_flight_002
Text: The Burn: endless dark forest grown thick over old fire scars. A frozen private lake. On its far shore, a stone-and-glass mansion, steam rising from its roofs. Behind it, a black cone of rock breathing a column of white steam into the blue sky.

Name: p2e6_flight_003
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Is that a volcano?

Name: p2e6_flight_004
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: Locals call it the Smoke. Geologists say it can't exist. (beat) It does anyway.

Name: p2e6_flight_005
Text: A sharp crack. A hole punches through the fuselage beside Preethi's head. A second crack. Oil sprays across the windshield. The engine coughs.

Name: p2e6_flight_006
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: Rifle! From the ridge! Hold on!

Name: p2e6_flight_007
Text: Black smoke. The engine dies. In the silence, only wind. Daniel fights the stick, gliding toward a long frozen lake in the heart of the Burn. The ice rushes up.

Name: p2e6_flight_008
Text: Impact. White.

Name: p2e6_end_000
Text: End of Episode 6.

Name: p2e7_open_000
Text: The Norseman lies on its skis on the ice, one wing crumpled, the propeller bent. Steam from the engine. You pull yourself out of the cockpit. Preethi is already beside Daniel, whose leg is bent the wrong way below the knee.

Name: p2e7_open_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Broken. Closed fracture. (To Daniel.) This will hurt very much.

Name: p2e7_open_002
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: You're a pharmacist, not a— AHH.

Name: p2e7_daniel_000
Speaker: DANIEL
Text: (grey, sweating) Go. I'll fix the radio and keep the flare gun warm. When you're done, fire a green flare and I'll call it in. (beat) If you're not back by dark, I'm eating your sambar rice.

Name: p2e7_daniel_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: …Anna… I'm here. I'm listening to them. I'm in their radio.

Name: p2e7_shore_000
Text: The tree line. Snowmobile engines somewhere. Two hunters in white camouflage working the shore, rifles slung. They don't know the plane came down this far west.

Name: p2e7_disguise_000
Text: You take the first hunter's white parka, his toque and his radio. In the whites, from fifty metres, you're one of them.

Name: p2e7_disguise_001
Text: Preethi looks you up and down. "You look like a marshmallow with a gun."

Name: p2e7_ridge_000
Text: A ridge of black, dead trunks from the old fire, new pines thick below. A glint on the crest.

Name: p2e7_ridge_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: Sniper. The same one who shot the plane.

Name: p2e7_ridge_002
Text: You spot for her with the binoculars: "Three hundred. Wind left."

Name: p2e7_ridge2_000
Text: In the sniper's nest: another NSB grenade case, and a map of the hunters' patrol routes. A camp on the north trail. An ammo cabin in the ravine. A fire lookout tower where the routes meet.

Name: p2e7_ridge2_001
Speaker: MANI
Text: We split. Meet at the fire lookout.

Name: p2e7_ridge2_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: I hate this plan.

Name: p2e7_ridge2_003
Speaker: MANI
Text: Nila made it.

Name: p2e7_ridge2_004
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: I hate it less.

Name: p2e7_camp_000
Text: A hunters' camp: tents, a fire, four men, two dogs. In the white parka you could walk right through it. Or bait the wolves you've heard all morning toward the meat rack.

Name: p2e7_cabin_000
Text: A frozen creek and an old trapper's cabin, now an ammo dump. Three guards inside. Preethi can go under the cabin through the crawlspace, or through the front door with the shotgun.

Name: p2e7_meet_000
Text: You reach the old steel fire lookout tower at the same moment, from opposite sides. Preethi has a cut on her cheek and a stolen box of shells under her arm. You hold each other for exactly three seconds.

Name: p2e7_ice_000
Text: Beyond the lookout, a long lake to cross. Too many snowmobiles. Kane's voice on the hunters' channel, organising them.

Name: p2e7_ice_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: Anna… give me the hunter's radio.

Name: p2e7_ice_002
Text: You hold the captured radio against your own. Nila, in Windsor, listens for a full minute. Then she speaks on Kane's channel in Kane's clipped, flat voice.

Name: p2e7_ice_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: All units. Targets on the south lake. Intercept. Now.

Name: p2e7_ice_004
Text: Engines roar. Eight snowmobiles race out onto the south lake, where the current keeps the ice thin.

Name: p2e7_ice_005
Text: Preethi looks at you. She doesn't say anything.

Name: p2e7_ice_warn_000
Speaker: MANI
Text: Thin ice! South lake is thin ice! Turn back!

Name: p2e7_ice_warn_001
Text: The snowmobiles skid, turn, scatter. Every one of them makes it back to shore. Now they know exactly where you are.

Name: p2e7_ice_warn_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: …You were right. I'm glad you were right.

Name: p2e7_ice_let_000
Text: The ice opens. The lake takes machines and men. Then it's quiet, except for the wind.

Name: p2e7_ice_let_001
Text: Preethi doesn't say anything for a long time.

Name: p2e7_ice_let_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: …Anna, I'm sorry. I'm sorry I made you do that.

Name: p2e7_kane1_000
Text: Kane, shoulder bandaged from Starratt-Olsen, waits at the top of the lookout with a heavy rifle.

Name: p2e7_kane1_001
Speaker: KANE
Text: (shouting down) He said you'd come! He said you'd both come! He's got a bet on which of you dies first!

Name: p2e7_kane2_000
Text: Close quarters on the switchback stairs. Two of Kane's men between you and the top.

Name: p2e7_kane3_000
Text: Wind. Kane grabs Preethi as she comes up through the hatch and holds her out over the rail. You have one grenade and one magazine left.

Name: p2e7_kane3_001
Speaker: KANE
Text: Drop it, or she flies.

Name: p2e7_kane_bad_000
Text: Kane laughs and leans Preethi further out. Her boots scrape at nothing. No. Not like this.

Name: p2e7_kane_bad_001
Text: Think. The grenade.

Name: p2e7_kane_end_000
Text: The grenade sails off the far side and bursts in the trees below. Kane's head snaps toward the blast. Preethi drives her elbow into his wounded shoulder and twists free. Kane staggers back against the rail, which gives way.

Name: p2e7_kane_end_001
Text: He hangs from the edge by one hand. You reach him.

Name: p2e7_kane_end_002
Speaker: KANE
Text: He'll give you the cure. (A thin laugh.) He wants you to watch him choose which one.

Name: p2e7_kane_end_003
Text: His grip fails. He falls into the trees.

Name: p2e7_cliff_000
Text: From the top of the tower, everything is visible. The frozen private lake below. On its far shore, the Hades Mansion, every window lit gold, steam pouring from vents on its roofs. Behind it, the Smoke breathes a white column into the violet sky.

Name: p2e7_cliff_001
Text: In a glass-walled courtyard, something large and striped paces.

Name: p2e7_cliff_002
Text: Preethi loads her last shells. You count the grenades.

Name: p2e7_cliff_003
Text: The radio clicks onto your private channel. A calm voice, warm and pleased.

Name: p2e7_cliff_004
Speaker: HADES
Text: Come in. Shoes off, please. I've made tea.

Name: p2e7_end_000
Text: End of Episode 7.

Name: p2e8_open_000
Text: Night. Minus thirty-five. You and Preethi cross the lake on foot in the hunters' whites, low and fast. The mansion grows ahead: stone walls, glass wings glowing green and gold, steam rising from copper vents. A thick pipe runs from the house up the slope of the Smoke.

Name: p2e8_open_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: He heats it from the volcano. That's how his animals survive up here. (beat) Anna. Anni. Whatever's in that house, it's alive and it's hungry. Go slow.

Name: p2e8_open_002
Text: Three ways in.

Name: p2e8_kennels_000
Text: Wolf-dog hybrids pace a heated run. Two guards in the gatehouse with a thermos and a card game. Preethi crushes her sedatives into a hunk of the dogs' own meat.

Name: p2e8_roof_000
Text: The boathouse roof is coated in ice. Three metres of it to the balcony rail, with a twenty-metre drop to the frozen lake.

Name: p2e8_roof_slip_000
Text: Your boot slides. Preethi grabs your parka hood and hauls. You lie on the ice together, breathing, then crawl the rest.

Name: p2e8_loud_000
Text: The grenade blows the generator shed apart. Every light dies for thirty seconds, then flickers back on the geothermal backup. Guards run toward the noise.

Name: p2e8_hall_000
Text: Inside. Warm air, stone floors, the smell of wet earth and something like a zoo. Corridors lead off in every direction.

Name: p2e8_hall_001
Speaker: NILA
Text: He's in the study, upstairs. He's waiting. But the vault codes, the layout, anything you learn first, it all helps.

Name: p2e8_tiger_000
Text: A heated glass yard. A Siberian tiger lies on a warm rock, watching you with complete calm. Two guards patrol the corridor on the far side of the glass. Two gates: the inner gate into the yard, the outer gate into the guards' corridor. A lever for each.

Name: p2e8_tiger_001
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: He keeps a tiger. Of course he keeps a tiger.

Name: p2e8_cons_000
Text: A jungle under glass, hot and dripping. Free-roaming golden lanceheads among the roots. A black mamba draped along the rafters. Poison dart frogs on the leaves like sweets.

Name: p2e8_cons_001
Text: Move slowly. Light every step. Don't touch the leaves.

Name: p2e8_cons_bite_000
Text: A gold blur from the roots. Preethi cries out. Two punctures in her ankle above the boot.

Name: p2e8_cons_bite_001
Text: Her hands are shaking but steady enough. She draws the antivenom from the Hayden Deep fridge and injects herself in the thigh. You hold her through the worst of it.

Name: p2e8_cons_bite_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (through her teeth) Good thing I'm a pharmacist.

Name: p2e8_cons_ok_000
Text: At the far end of the conservatory, a service corridor and a ring of keys on a hook: the household keys, labelled. One says VAULT — MH.

Name: p2e8_pool_000
Text: A dark, warm saltwater pool. Things move under the surface: saltwater crocodiles. A catwalk crosses above, and a guard walks it back and forth.

Name: p2e8_pool_bad_000
Text: The guard turns. A shot cracks off the tiles. You hit him before he fires again and he goes over the rail. You don't look at the water. Neither does Preethi.

Name: p2e8_pool_ok_000
Text: You cross in his shadow, step for step. He never turns. Below you, something large rolls lazily in the dark water.

Name: p2e8_trophy_000
Text: Stuffed animals from every continent, glass eyes catching the light. A portrait gallery.

Name: p2e8_trophy_001
Text: Robert Hayden in a long dark coat, 1978, beside the Merrow dam. A boy with a jar of snakes on a windowsill. A young man at a university lab bench. A plaque: "Hayden Family Trust — est. 1934."

Name: p2e8_trophy_002
Speaker: MANI
Text: The coat. It's the same coat.

Name: p2e8_trophy_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: Father and son. (beat) Anna. Which one have we been listening to?

Name: p2e8_radio_000
Text: Floor-to-ceiling equipment. Racks of recordings labelled by date: every one of Nila's broadcasts from Greyhaven, and her new show in Windsor. A wall of photos of Nila taken from a distance: at Pike Point, at the Windsor studio, asleep in hospital.

Name: p2e8_radio_001
Text: Nila, listening through your radio, hears her own voice playing on a loop in his room.

Name: p2e8_radio_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: …Anna. Burn it. All of it.

Name: p2e8_study_000
Text: A wood-panelled study. A fire. Tea in a china pot on a low table. A golden lancehead coiled on the desk like a sleeping cat. Behind the desk, for the first time, his face.

Name: p2e8_study_001
Text: Mark Hayden, fifty-eight, silver-haired, soft-voiced, the long dark coat over a cashmere sweater.

Name: p2e8_study_002
Speaker: HADES
Text: Shoes. (You don't move.) Fine. (He pours three cups.) Preethi, the pharmacist. Mani, the analyst. And Nila. I assume you're listening, Lighthouse.

Name: p2e8_study_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: I'm listening, Mark.

Name: p2e8_study_004
Text: He smiles, pleased, like a man hearing a favourite song.

Name: p2e8_study_005
Speaker: HADES
Text: Your sister is the most interesting person I've ever listened to. A hundred nights of a voice in the dark, telling the truth to people who don't want it.

Name: p2e8_study_006
Speaker: HADES
Text: Victor talked too much, so I stopped him. My father always said, never let the help speak at the table.

Name: p2e8_study_007
Speaker: MANI
Text: Why her?

Name: p2e8_study_008
Speaker: HADES
Text: She was the perfect subject: young, healthy, isolated, curious. She cost me Greyhaven. And I knew you'd come. (He looks at you.) Brothers always come.

Name: p2e8_offer_000
Text: He sets three identical glass vials on the desk, each with a white cap. A, B, C.

Name: p2e8_offer_001
Speaker: HADES
Text: One of these is HX-7C, the cure. The other two are HX-7, concentrated. One dose of that and she dies by morning. (beat) Give me the file, and choose. I'll let you take whichever one you pick. I want to see if you can save her.

Name: p2e8_offer_002
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: You'll just let us walk out.

Name: p2e8_offer_003
Speaker: HADES
Text: I'm a collector, Preethi. I collect moments.

Name: p2e8_offer_004
Text: Preethi asks for one minute and opens her pharmacy kit on his desk. He nods, delighted.

Name: p2e8_offer_005
Text: From the Hayden Deep files, she knows what HX-7C should do: a faint blue colour reaction, needle-shaped crystals, and slightly basic, around pH 7.6. She runs three tests on each vial.

Name: p2e8_offer_006
Text: Vial A: stays clear. Flat plate crystals. pH 6.8.

Name: p2e8_offer_007
Text: Vial B: faint blue. Needle crystals. pH 7.6.

Name: p2e8_offer_008
Text: Vial C: stays clear. Needle crystals. pH 7.4.

Name: p2e8_usb_000
Speaker: HADES
Text: (applauding softly) Oh, she's good. She's very good.

Name: p2e8_usb_001
Text: You hand over the USB. He plugs it into his laptop. Blank. Wiped.

Name: p2e8_usb_002
Speaker: NILA
Text: I erased it remotely this morning, Mark. You never needed it. You just wanted us here.

Name: p2e8_usb_003
Text: Hades looks at the empty screen for a long moment. Then he laughs, genuinely.

Name: p2e8_usb_004
Speaker: HADES
Text: I'm going to miss you, Lighthouse.

Name: p2e8_usb_005
Text: Outside, across the lake, a green flare climbs into the sky. Daniel. Then, far off, the thud of helicopter rotors.

Name: p2e8_usb_006
Text: Hades sighs and presses a button under the desk. Deep below the house, valves open. The pipes scream. Steam explodes from vents in every wing. Glass shatters in the conservatory. The animals are loose.

Name: p2e8_escape_000
Text: Steam, falling glass, alarms. Guards between you and the back terrace, where Hades is disappearing up the slope of the Smoke.

Name: p2e8_smoke_000
Text: The black cone above you, hot under your boots despite the snow. Steam everywhere. Hades on a ledge, the golden lancehead around his arm, the coat whipping in the hot wind.

Name: p2e8_smoke_001
Speaker: HADES
Text: You know what my father will say? That I played with my food. (beat) He's right.

Name: p2e8_smoke_002
Text: The ground cracks between you. A column of scalding steam erupts from the fissure with a roar. When it clears, the ledge is empty. A golden lancehead slides away over the rocks. The coat is gone. No body.

Name: p2e8_smoke_003
Text: Neither of you fired. The Smoke took him.

Name: p2e8_heli_000
Text: An OPP helicopter lands on the ice, rotor wash blasting snow. Dunn jumps out, then two paramedics carrying Daniel on a stretcher, grinning, leg splinted.

Name: p2e8_heli_001
Speaker: DUNN
Text: Your journalist sent the lab files to every newspaper in the country an hour ago. The judge in Kenora stopped golfing. (beat) Get in.

Name: p2e8_heli_002
Text: Preethi holds the vial in both hands inside her parka, against her heart, the whole flight.

Name: p2e8_hosp_000
Text: Dr. Singh. Dr. Marchetti on a video call from Red Lake. Preethi with three pages of notes. The first dose.

Name: p2e8_hosp_001
Text: A long, silent wait. Amma praying under her breath. Appa holding Nila's hand. Ortiz asleep in a plastic chair in the corridor.

Name: p2e8_hosp_002
Text: Nila's eyes open.

Name: p2e8_hosp_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: Anna… Anni… neenga romba late.
Subtitle: You two are very late.

Name: p2e8_hosp_004
Speaker: PREETHI
Text: (crying and laughing) Traffic.

Name: p2e8_pongal_000
Text: Appa said it a year ago: "Come home for Pongal." The pongal pot boils over on the stove for luck and everyone shouts "Pongalo pongal!" A kolam at the door. Sugarcane in the corner. Amma and Appa in person this time.

Name: p2e8_pongal_001
Text: Ortiz, Ruth and Jonah on a video call from Greyhaven. Daniel, Ivy and Dunn on another from Red Lake. Daniel's leg is in a cast covered in signatures.

Name: p2e8_pongal_002
Text: Nila, thinner, hair short, laughing, back on her feet.

Name: p2e8_pongal_003
Speaker: NILA
Text: Appa, poana varusham nee sonna, Pongal-ku veetuku vaanu. (beat) Naan vandhutten.
Subtitle: Appa, last year you said come home for Pongal. (beat) I came.

Name: p2e8_hook_000
Text: Preethi sits on the edge of the bed, holding something behind her back. She shows you a pregnancy test. Positive.

Name: p2e8_hook_001
Text: You stare at it. Then at her. Joy, so big it's quiet.

Name: p2e8_hook_002
Text: In the living room, Nila's old radio, switched off on the shelf, clicks to static on its own. An old man's voice, slow and amused:

Name: p2e8_hook_003
Speaker: OLD MAN
Text: Congratulations, Anni.

Name: p2e8_hook_004
Text: Silence. Nobody hears it.

Name: p2_end_000
Text: A stone house somewhere you have never seen. Snow at the windows.

Name: p2_end_001
Text: A very old man in a long dark coat, Robert Hayden, sits beside a hospital bed.

Name: p2_end_002
Text: In the bed, burned and bandaged, Mark Hayden opens his eyes.

Name: p2_end_003
Text: "You played with your food, Mark," the old man says. "Now we do it properly."

Name: p2_end_004
Text: OUT OF TOWN WILL RETURN.
